description: This file is a source code implementation for the Radio Interface Layer (RIL) in Android, handling communication between the Android telephony framework and the radio hardware. It includes functions for request handling, unsolicited responses, wake lock management, and event loop control, with references to external telephony and hardware interface headers.

classes.name: UserCallbackInfo
classes.description: Structure to hold callback information for timed user callbacks, including the callback function, user parameters, event data, and linked list pointer.

classes.name: UnsolResponseInfo
classes.description: Structure defining unsolicited response handlers, including request number, response function, and wake lock type.

classes.name: CommandInfo
classes.description: Structure representing command details, including request number, response function, and associated request string.

classes.name: RequestInfo
classes.description: Structure representing an ongoing request, including token, request command info, socket ID, and status flags.

methods.name: addRequestToList
methods.description: Adds a new request to the pending requests list for a specific socket ID.

methods.name: triggerEvLoop
methods.description: Triggers the event loop to wake up, typically by writing to a wakeup file descriptor.

methods.name: rilEventAddWakeup
methods.description: Adds an event to the event loop and triggers it.

methods.name: processWakeupCallback
methods.description: Handles wakeup events by reading from the wakeup file descriptor.

methods.name: resendLastNITZTimeData
methods.description: Resends the last NITZ time data to the specified socket if available.

methods.name: onNewCommandConnect
methods.description: Handles actions upon establishing a new command connection, including notifying connection and version info.

methods.name: userTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a user timer expires, executing the associated callback.

methods.name: eventLoop
methods.description: Main event loop thread function, initializes event handling and manages wakeup pipe.

methods.name: RIL_startEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the event loop in a dedicated thread and waits for it to initialize.

methods.name: RIL_setcallbacks
methods.description: Sets the callback functions for RIL operations.

methods.name: RIL_register
methods.description: Registers the RIL with provided callback functions, performs self-checks, and registers services.

methods.name: RIL_register_socket
methods.description: Registers socket-based RIL functions, initializes sockets, and registers services.

methods.name: checkAndDequeueRequestInfoIfAck
methods.description: Checks and removes a request info from the pending list if it is an acknowledgment.

methods.name: RIL_onRequestAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of a request, removing it from pending list and acknowledging the radio request.

methods.name: RIL_onRequestComplete
methods.description: Completes a request, sends response, and manages wake locks and pending request list.

methods.name: grabPartialWakeLock
methods.description: Acquires a partial wake lock and sets a timeout for wake lock release.

methods.name: releaseWakeLock
methods.description: Releases the wake lock, managing internal counters.

methods.name: wakeTimeoutCallback
methods.description: Callback to release wake lock before timeout.

methods.name: RIL_onUnsolicitedResponse
methods.description: Handles unsolicited responses from the radio, including wake lock management and response dispatch.
